newsitem.title: GERMANY: TABLE - WESTLB H1 PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - WESTLB H1 PROFIT RISES.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after provisions 749.6 vs 611.5
Group oper profit before provisions 956.0 vs 871.5
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale. The bank also said it expected a continued positive earnings trend in 1997.

Results compare with six-twelfths of the full-year 1996 results -- a practice abandoned by many German banks which have switched to year-on-year comparisons but still pursued by some banks which believe it irons out fluctuations and gives a truer picture of a bank's performance.
